business_summary: One 97 Communications (Paytm): consumer wallet/UPI/QR app with merchant payments (soundboxes, POS devices), subscription revenue, and distribution of loans, insurance and wealth products via partners. Post-RBI PPBL curbs (2024) it relies on third-party payments banks for UPI. Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs2,648cr (+28.5%), PAT ~Rs225cr, versus Rs21cr a year ago; Q1 FY27 GMV Rs7.1 lakh cr (+31%). Stock Rs1,797 (+50% in 6m, +42% in 12m), mcap Rs1.15 lakh cr, P/B ~8.5; Morgan Stanley upgraded and Bernstein is positive.

exposures.mechanism: +1 digital-payments adoption: payments GMV +25% (Q1 FY27 GMV Rs7.1 lakh cr, +31%) and merchant devices/subscriptions grow; payment+device revenue ~65% of sales => revenue +5%, with operating leverage (opex ~92% of sales) EBITDA +25% x EV/MCap 0.9 x persistence 0.3 => ~+6; discounted to +4 because UPI take-rate is near zero.

evidence.note: Paytm Q2 FY27: consolidated PAT ~Rs225cr (vs Rs21cr), revenue from operations Rs2,648cr (+28.5% YoY), exchange filing 2026-10-26 (Free Press Journal/Inc42/Devdiscourse via search; Q1 FY27 PAT Rs220cr, GMV Rs7.1 lakh cr +31%)

exposures.mechanism: +1 = government/RBI permits MDR or incentive on UPI merchant payments (currently 0% MDR; incentive scheme only). Paytm UPI P2M volume ~Rs7 lakh cr GMV/qtr (Q1 FY27); each 1bp take-rate on Rs28 lakh cr annual GMV = Rs28cr vs TTM PAT Rs618cr (screener); +5bp = +Rs140cr post-tax x EV/MCap 0.9 x persistence 0.6 => ~+6 central. Speculative; no proposal confirmed in fetched sources.

+1 tightening step on payment aggregators/wallets/KYC, or lending-partner norms (digital lending directions, FLDG caps): the earlier PPBL curbs show regulator risk; a new action hitting merchant-lending distribution (revenue ~20%) or PA licence would cut EBITDA -15% x persistence 0.5 => ~-3.

+1pp delinquencies on small-ticket loans distributed via partners (postpaid, personal loans, merchant loans; financial services ~15-20% of revenue, model): FLDG exposure and lower disbursement => EBITDA -8% x 0.9 x 0.5 => -2.5.
+5pp urban consumption growth -> GMV +3% -> payment revenue +3% with leverage -> EBITDA +15% x 0.9 x 0.2 => +2.5.
+$5bn/qtr: beta 0.44-0.64 per pack shows low market beta, but high flows-sensitivity of FII-held growth names (stock +50% in 6m, 52w high 2026-09-11) => +5.
+5 VIX points: pack -1.06 per SSU (t -1.1); 40% annual volatility; -2.
+25bp repo: Paytm holds ~Rs12-13k cr cash/treasury (model estimate) => +Rs30cr pre-tax interest (~+4% of TTM PAT Rs618cr) partly offset by lower partner-lending demand => +0.8.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Hindu/Reuters/CNBC TV18 headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +3pp bank credit growth -> partner banks/NBFCs distribute more loans via Paytm: loan-distribution revenue +8% x 20% of sales = +1.6% sales => +1.5 equity.
+5% S&P 500: pack +2.43 per SSU (t +1.5) as growth-tech sentiment; shrunk to +1.0.
+1 GenAI: management cites AI-led cost savings and opportunities (Tribune/IANS Nov 2025 for Q2 FY26; Q2 FY27 not verified): opex -2% => EBITDA +20% x 0.9 x 0.15 => ~+1.
Pack +8.84 (t +2.5) with market beta 0.44: no business mechanism for coal; likely a regime artefact; shrunk by 90%.
